name: unanswered_deals_list
description: The individual open deals nobody has written back to — with the contact, stage, owner, value, how long the deal has been open and how long the customer has been waiting. Use for 'which deals do I need to reply to', 'show me the deals nobody has answered', 'who is waiting on a reply', 'give me the list to chase'. Deals where the customer has written are the urgent ones: they are actively waiting. For the summary counts rather than the list, use the open deals never replied to skill.

params.name: min_days_open
params.description: Only deals open at least this many days. Use for 'anything unanswered for over a week'.

params.name: min_customer_messages
params.description: Only deals where the customer has written at least this many times. Pass 1 for 'who is actually waiting on us'.

params.name: owner
params.description: Narrow to one rep by name.

params.name: stage
params.description: Narrow to one pipeline stage by name.
